请先作答，才能进入下一题: Answer first to continue to the next question
正在保存上一步，稍等一下: Saving the previous step, one moment
从勾选的题组里抽单选 / 多选题，先覆盖不同主题；交卷后统一判分。: Draws single- and multiple-choice questions from the decks you tick, covering different topics first. Everything is graded when you hand in.
勾选要考的题组，选好题型和题数。: Tick the decks to be examined on, then choose the question types and how many questions.
点「开始考试」，限时 {0} 分钟，到时自动交卷。: Press Start exam. You have {0} minutes, and the paper is handed in automatically when time is up.
作答中不显示对错，可以上一题 / 下一题，反复修改。: Right and wrong are not shown while you answer. Move between questions and change answers freely.
交卷后看成绩单；答错和没答的题可以一键排进学习路径。: After you hand in you get a score report. Wrong and unanswered questions can go straight into your study path.
再考一次时，优先抽没考过的题；题库不够时会重复。: On a retake, questions you have not sat yet come first. Questions repeat when the bank runs short.
选一种考试形式，在限定时间里完成；交卷或结束后看成绩、反馈和薄弱点。: Pick an exam format and sit it against the clock. When you hand in or finish, you get scores, feedback and weak spots.
像面试官当面提问：你回答，可以被追问，整场结束后一次性给出反馈。: Like an interviewer asking you in person: you answer, you may be asked a follow-up, and all feedback comes together at the end.
屏幕上会出现一道题，像面试官当面提问；题目来自你选的学习库范围。: A question appears on screen as if an interviewer asked it. Questions come from the library scope you chose.
把你口头回答的要点写在输入框里（目前是文字作答，没有语音输入）。: Type the key points of what you would say in the box. Answers are typed for now; there is no voice input.
想被追问就点「追问一次」，每道题最多追问一次。: Press Ask one follow-up if you want to be probed. Each question gets at most one follow-up.
点「保存并继续」进入下一题；回答保存在本地学习库。: Press Save & continue for the next question. Your answers are kept in your local library.
整场结束后一次性给出每题反馈，中途不显示对错。: Feedback for every question comes together after the whole round. Right and wrong are not shown along the way.

1–10 题 · 每个主题先出一题，薄弱和没考过的主题优先。: 1–10 questions · one question per topic first, weak and unseen topics first.
学习库里还没有可用于口头模拟的题；先出题再来。: No questions in your library can be used for an oral interview yet. Create some first.
发给 AI 模型的内容：追问时是当前题目和你的回答；结束评估时是题目、参考答案和: What is sent to the AI model: for a follow-up, the current question and your answer; for the final assessment, the questions, reference answers and all your answers. Nothing else from your library is sent.
限时完成一套案例题：先阅读并高亮线索，再按分值分配时间作答。: Sit a case paper against the clock: read and highlight clues first, then spend your writing time by marks.
选一套案例卷，或点「新出一份案例卷」让 AI 按课程资料出一套。: Pick a case paper, or press New case paper to have the AI write one from your course materials.
先读：阅读时间里只能看案例和题目，用不同颜色高亮线索。: Read first: during reading time you can only read the case and the questions, and highlight clues in different colours.
再写：按每题分值分配作答时间，页面会显示每题的建议用时。: Then write: split your writing time by marks. The page shows each question's suggested time.
交卷后按评分标准逐条给分，并给出改写建议；批改由 AI 模型完成，结果也会进信箱: After you hand in, each marking criterion is scored and you get rewrite suggestions. The AI model does the marking, and results also reach your inbox.
每套案例一次考完，可以重考；最好成绩显示在学习库。: Each case is sat in one go and can be retaken. Your best score shows in the library.
